claims.claim: Lake Hestholm, Denmark (253 ha, shallow), September: ~21 young-of-year pike/ha lake-wide (~117/ha of vegetated littoral)
claims.location: p. 30–31 (PDF pp. 31–32), section 2.3.2.1 PASE; Fig. 9, p. 31 (PDF p. 32)
claims.quote: Gedder i vegetationen : 465000 m2 x 0,0117 gedder/ m2 = 5423 gedder
claims.conditions: point-abundance electrofishing (PASE) on 18 and 27 September 2002: 490 points in the vegetation and 386 in open water caught five pike, four 0+ (all in the vegetation) and one 1+ (open water), so Fig. 9 assigns the vegetation estimate (5,423) to the 2002 year class; lake area 253 ha measured 14 May 2002 (206.5 ha open water, 46.5 ha shore vegetation); a lake created in winter 2000 in the Skjern Å restoration
claims.note: 5,423 / 253 ha = 21.4/ha; 5,423 / 46.5 ha = 116.6/ha. The estimate rests on four fish. The lake-wide September total of all ages was 13,065 pike = 51.6/ha (p. 45); the summary gives the lake as 242 ha (open water in 2002, Koed 2002).

claims.claim: 0+ pike survived 17.5 % from May to September
claims.location: p. 30–31 (PDF pp. 31–32), section 2.3.2.1 PASE (catches and estimates); Fig. 9 (read on the page image)
claims.quote: Fangsten bestod i alt af 53 gedder fordelt på 24 0+ gedder, 28 1+ gedder
claims.conditions: May PASE (15 and 24 May 2002) estimated 68,363 pike, of which 24 of the 53 caught were 0+ → ~30,957 0+ (Fig. 9 ~31,000); June (24 June) ~20,300 0+ (Fig. 9); September 5,423 0+. Apparent survival: the counts fell through bird predation (grey herons, cormorants; the author's main explanation) and probably emigration of small 0+ to Skjern Å, which the author suspected; the May run fell while the 2002 fry were still hatching
claims.note: 5,423 / 30,957 = 0.175 (May→June ≈ 0.66, June→September ≈ 0.27, read off Fig. 9). Say 'apparent survival (losses include emigration)'; the estimates rest on 24, ~10 and 4 young pike caught.

claims.claim: 0+ pike survived about 46 % from December to March
claims.source_value: the thesis gives no winter survival. The 46 % is a ratio of two electrofishing catch rates (CPUE) for the 2002 year class: ~0.35 pike/min in December 2002 (read off Fig. 7c) and 0.16 pike/min on 26 March 2003 (text). The same index had risen from ~0.11 in November to ~0.35 in December, so the ratio is not a survival estimate
claims.location: p. 27 (PDF p. 28), section 2.3.1.1 CPUE Hestholm Sø; Fig. 7c, p. 28 (PDF p. 29)
claims.quote: i slutningen af marts (d. 26.03.03) var faldet til 0,16 gedder/minut
claims.conditions: boat electrofishing catch per minute, monthly rounds March 2002–March 2003 (no rounds January–February); CPUE for the 2002 year class peaked at 0.52 on 5 June 2002
claims.note: drop '~46 % from December to March' or present it as 'the catch rate of young pike fell by about half between December and late March'

notes: The research note's values (esocid_first_year_survival.md) are project readings of Fig. 9 and Fig. 7c, not numbers the thesis states; the September density is right only for the 0+ caught in the vegetation. Other values: total pike density 270.2/ha in May, 145.6/ha in June and 51.6/ha in September 2002 (p. 45); 0+ density 122.4/ha in June (p. 45, compared with ~190 0+/ha in stocked Udbyover Sø); the PIT-tagged 2001-cohort pike with the lowest growth all bore fresh bird-beak wounds (Fig. 16, p. 40); growth started and stopped near 10 °C, a little higher for the 2002 0+ (p. 36). Delrapport 2 (pp. 58–74) covers migration between the lake and Skjern Å.
